name: Gemini in Chrome
launch.detail: Enables Gemini in Chrome in Chrome's profile settings and starts Chrome with the Gemini switches; needs a US network exit
restart.detail: Closes the running Chrome, enables Gemini in Chrome in its profile settings and starts it again with the Gemini switches; needs a US network exit
country.unknown: Could not check the network exit country; Chrome was not started
country.other: Gemini needs a US network exit, but the current exit is {country}; Chrome was not started
repair.failed: Could not update Chrome's Gemini settings: {error}
